instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Fusion Capital is a boutique legal firm specializing in complex commercial dispute resolution, intellectual property litigation, and corporate white-collar defense. The team handles high-stakes matters involving thousands of documents per case, requiring sophisticated e-discovery tools to manage information overflow efficiently.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company utilizes an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas quarterly to the investment committee. Approved projects receive six months of funded incubation with dedicated resources, successfully graduating one project into a distinct standalone business unit focused on automated contract review.
answers.strategicGoals: The firm is heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base representing 55% of total revenue. To ensure long-term viability, the goal is to identify new revenue streams by developing specialized compliance tools for mid-sized corporations or launching an entirely new vertical legal consulting service.
answers.additionalContext: The firm is currently facing intense competition from large legal tech providers and specialized boutique AI startups, requiring rapid adaptation to capture emerging automation opportunities.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven E-Discovery Workflow Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Implement advanced predictive coding algorithms to significantly reduce document review time and cost for existing clients. This leverages current digital maturity (4) to improve operational efficiency immediately.

first_actions: Pilot a proprietary ML model on 3 key active cases.
Integrate the pilot tool into the core e-discovery platform roadmap.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average document review hours by 30% within 6 months
milestones: Q2: Model successful in pilot phase.

opportunities.title: Subscription Compliance Monitoring Platform
opportunities.rationale: Develop a radical pivot into a SaaS model offering continuous, automated regulatory compliance monitoring as a subscription service. This moves the business from high-margin transactional work to scalable recurring revenue.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated team (4 engineers + 1 PM) for MVP development.
Conduct market validation interviews with regulatory consultants.
resources_needed: Hiring budget for specialized compliance engineer ($60,000)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 pilot subscription clients by end of year
milestones: Q1 Next Year: Launch beta offering.

next_steps.action: Formalize the 'Compliance SaaS' business case and secure initial funding approval from the formal committee.
Launch a cross-functional workshop to address cultural barriers preventing rapid adoption of radical ideas.

key_weaknesses: Rigid formal innovation process slowing market response speed
High dependence on concentrated revenue streams (55% from top 3 clients)
Cultural resistance to adopting radical, unproven business models
Talent gap in specialized regulatory SaaS development and subscription marketing.
